findings.where: meta line 'Tw93 Open Source Family' (#8e9db3 on #1B365D)
findings.evidence: Computed 4.40:1 at 30 px regular on the 1242 canvas; it passes as large text on the full-size image but once the card is viewed in a feed (about 2.8x smaller, SOC-109) it becomes ~11 px text at 4.4:1, below the 4.5:1 normal-text threshold.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), applied at viewing size for a phone-viewed canvas.
findings.title: Text contrast on real pixels
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten ground; never thin weights on tinted ground.

findings.where: html > body.paper-ink > section.card.cover > div.meta:nth-of-type(1)  "Tw93 Open Source Family"
findings.evidence: 23-character run at 30px (hard floor 28px, dense UI 32px, body 36px)
findings.title: Text size floors
findings.fix: Raise to the floor; cut words rather than shrink.

findings.evidence: "A quiet keeper for your Mac." Failed T-RIVAL-NAME: CleanMyMac, Stats or iStat Menus could all carry it. Failed T-THREE-LINE: not picturable, not falsifiable. 'Quiet' is a virtue word about the product (SLP-135 house voice: warm, modest, literary).
findings.after: Say the job the screenshot proves, e.g. 'CPU, memory, disk and battery in the menu bar; cleans what you uninstall' [DATA NEEDED: Mole's own one-line description]
findings.why: The one line of copy on the card spends itself on tone; T-FIVE-SECOND 'what is it' is answered only by the screenshot.
findings.title: Cap virtue words about the business (honest, calm, quiet, actually, genuine, truly, simply

findings.evidence: alt="Mole menu bar status panel" names the image but not what it tells; when posted, the platform alt text should carry the key facts the card shows.
findings.after: alt="Mole's menu bar panel: health score 100, CPU 14%, memory 72%, disk 292 GB free, battery 80%, top processes by memory"; reuse as the post's alt text
findings.title: Meaningful images get alt describing what they show

findings.evidence: The app panel occupies about 350 x 900 px of a 1050 px wide frame; the rest is macOS wallpaper. At feed size (canvas shown ~2.8x smaller) the panel's 11-13 px-equivalent labels (CPU 14%, Top Processes) fall to about 4 px. Failed T-THUMBNAIL for the product evidence.
findings.before: Full wallpaper crop around a narrow panel
findings.after: Crop to the panel (or its top half: score 100, CPU, MEM, Disk) and scale it up so the key readings stay legible in the feed
findings.why: The real product is the card's best material; the wallpaper takes two thirds of its space.
findings.title: Test thumbnail legibility
